entries.head: promql
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser enforces clamp's three-argument signature. lowerClamp forwards the original parsed call from lowerCall; lowerMathCall reaches this shared kernel only for the clamp family, and its direct mixed-root adapter additionally checks the call's arity in mathCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp. lowerSubqueryIdentityMathReorder is a third caller, reached only from lowerSubqueryOverCall's own clamp/clamp_min/clamp_max case over the SAME unmodified parsed call. None of the three routes rewrites the argument slice, so a parsed clamp cannot reach this arity guard.

guard: past exhaustive switch c.Func.Name over [case "clamp_max", fnClampMin; case "clamp"]
